SECRET & CONFIDENTIAL REPORT

Subject (in full) Opium Robbery at North Honan Road on October 2, 1932.

Made by D.I. Papp Forwarded by Supt. Quayle.

With reference to the attached report, relating to
an opium robbery, which occurred on October, 2, 1932, I respectfully
beg to forward the following additional information :-
According to information, the smuggling of the opium,
referred to in the report, was carried out by a gang, of which
the notorious Wang Teh Kwei (王得贵) is the leader. After having
been successfully landed at Hunts Wharf, the opium was placed on
Van No.9612. The route of the van is given in detail in the
attached report, but according to information the robbery occured
about 1 p.m. October 2, 1932 near the Temple of Heaven, North
Honan Road near Soochow Road and was carried out by an armed gang,
which was led by one Siao Hupeh (小湖北) and Ling Fah (林发).
According to information received the detectives and
plain clothes men did not participate in the robbery, but it is
alleged that they are friendly with Wang Teh Kwei and that they
did have a small share in the opium which was robbed from Wang.
The bulk of the opium belongs to Kwang Chang (廣昌) alias Siao
Chang (小張).
In consequence of this occurrence there is now a
strained feeling between the detectives and Wang Teh Kwei (王得贵),
who is accused of dishonesty and efforts are being made to obtain
the return of the opium from the rival gang.
The above information is given with reservation,
because it is felt, that it will be extremely difficult to prove
this allegation.

秘密及机密报告

主题（全称） 1932年10月2日河南路北路鸦片抢劫案。

由警探长 Papp 制作，由警司 Quayle 转呈。

关于所附有关1932年10月2日发生的鸦片抢劫案的报告，谨此转呈以下补充信息：
据情报显示，报告中提及的鸦片走私由一个团伙实施，其头目为臭名昭著的王得贵（Wang Teh Kwei）。鸦片在亨特码头（Hunts Wharf）成功上岸后，被装上第9612号货车。货车的行驶路线在所附报告中有详细说明，但据情报称，抢劫发生于1932年10月2日下午1点左右，地点位于苏州路附近的河南路北路天通庵（Temple of Heaven）附近，由一个武装团伙实施，该团伙由小湖北（Siao Hupeh）和林发（Ling Fah）领导。
据收到的情报，便衣侦探并未参与此次抢劫，但有人指控他们与王得贵关系友好，并从王得贵被抢走的鸦片中小分了一杯羹。
大部分鸦片属于广昌（Kwang Chang），别名小张（Siao Chang）。
因此事发生，侦探与王得贵（王得贵）之间的关系目前趋于紧张，王得贵被指责不诚实，且正努力从敌对团伙手中追回鸦片。
提供上述信息时有所保留，因为认为极难证实这一指控。

（批注：可能无法证实 10月5日）

Oct. 5, 1932.

Sir,
We beg to bring to your notice that
C.P.Cs. 1825, 1858 and two other C.P.Cs. (number
unknown) attached to Hongkew Station who are on
plain clothes duty are working in conspiracy with
detectives Ting Pao Hsiang (祥保丁), Pao Shu Che (基樹包),(333)
Waung Tsoh Sung (生菊汪陽) and Sung Hai Chun (中漢沈)(35)
in affording protection to public opium smoking dens
and public gambling dens. They receive a monthly
allowance of $3.00 to $8.00 from each den. Those
dealing in opium are paying a monthly remuneration of
$10.00 per head and for temporary protection a sum of
$5.00 is paid to each officer who puts in an appearance.
On 1-10-32 one Wong Teh Kuei (青德王)
hired a truck from a Truck Company, No. 20 Hsian Road
(路安西) for the purpose of discharging opium from
the S.S. "Lien Ho" berthed at Ewo Wharf under the
protection of aforementioned officers. When the truck
was proceeding along Shanse Road the drug was plundered
and the truck left on the road unattended. It was later
taken back by the proprietor of the Garage. The
chauffeur of the truck must be able to furnish full data
in re.
The plain clothes constables and others
concerned subsequently met at Room No. 410, Central Hotel
(社旅央中) wherein a conclave was convened in the
course of which ways and means were devised to evade
responsibility.
We would like to point out that the
C.P.Cs. and Detectives in question not only neglected
their duty but even dared to afford protection to opium
dealers thereby making profit. Their act is certainly
most detrimental to the welfare of the community. We
have found it difficult to keep silent over the nefarious
activities of these public officers.
For fear of attracting enmity we have
refrained from making an open accusation and resorted
to the submission of this missive instead.
You are requested to cause investigations
to be instituted so as to ascertain facts of the case
and to obtain evidence on which the offenders may be
dealt with.
Your action in the case will serve as a
deterrent to others.

（左侧手写批注：are attached to Hongkew station / 1/8/10）

1932年10月1日，一名叫王德贵（音译）的人从西安路20号的一家卡车公司租用了一辆卡车，目的是在上述警员的保护下，从停靠在怡和码头的“联和”轮（S.S. "Lien Ho"）上卸运鸦片。当卡车沿山西路行驶时，毒品被劫，卡车被弃置在路上。后来卡车被车库主人收回。卡车司机应能提供有关此事的完整资料。
随后，这些便衣警员及相关人员在中旅社410室会面，召开秘密会议，期间策划了逃避责任的方法。
我们要指出，上述华捕和探员不仅玩忽职守，甚至胆敢为鸦片贩子提供保护以牟取私利。他们的行为无疑严重损害了社区福祉。对于这些公职人员的邪恶行径，我们觉得难以保持沉默。
因担心招致怨恨，我们未敢公开指控，而是转而提交此信。
恳请阁下展开调查，以查明案情事实，并获取证据以便惩处违法者。
阁下对此案的处理将对其他人起到震慑作用。

Between 2 and 4.20 p.m. on 2/9/32 I proceeded to the
Central Hotel, Hupeh Road, to see my informer Siau Lau Man
regarding some robbery cases. Whilst I was passing Room No. 304,
2nd floor, I noticed that there was a noisy crowd in that room,
I made enquiries amongst the tea-boys and I learnt from them
that it was the Crime Branch Headquarter detectives there, the
reason of their presence was unknown. As I could not find my
informer on that flat, I went downstairs, I waited for my
informer at the entrance of the Central Hotel for a long time,
but he did not turn up, so I hired a ricsha and returned to the
Station.

At about 10 a.m. on 2/10/32, I left the Station and
proceeded to Sections 3 and 4. whilst I was passing the Ziang
Tsung teashop, corner of Easteward and Arthur Roads, I met a
detective-second named Siau Nanking of the Narcotic Section, who
informs me that a large quantity of opium has been carried away
and misappropriated by an assistant named Siau Hupeh of the Wong
Tuh Kwei Company from Peking and Hokien Roads yesterday and a
lots of others, names unknown, concerned in this case has been
escaped. I told him to make further enquiries and let me know
later, but up to the present he did not come to see me. If you
want to know anything further regarding this case, I can go and
call Siau Nanking to the Station.

Sgd. Wang Tsoh Sung.

1932 年 9 月 2 日下午 2 时至 4 时 20 分之间，我前往湖北路中央饭店（Central Hotel），去见我的线人萧刘曼（Siau Lau Man），商谈几起抢劫案事宜。当我经过二楼 304 号房间时，注意到该房间内有一群喧闹的人。我向茶房打听，得知他们是刑事股总部的侦探，但其出现在此的原因不明。由于我在该楼层未能找到我的线人，我便下楼，在中央饭店门口等候线人许久，但他并未出现，于是我雇了一辆人力车返回捕房。

1932 年 10 月 2 日上午 10 时许，我离开捕房，前往第三和第四区。当我经过爱华德路（Eastward Road）与亚瑟路（Arthur Road）拐角处的祥宗茶馆（Ziang Tsung teashop）时，遇到禁毒组的一名二等侦探萧南京（Siau Nanking）。他告知我，昨天有大量鸦片被北京路与福建路黄杜桂公司（Wong Tuh Kwei Company）的一名助手萧湖北（Siau Hupeh）运走并侵吞，另有大量姓名不详的涉案人员已逃脱。我让他进一步调查并随后向我汇报，但截至目前他未来见我。若阁下欲知此案更多详情，我可去将萧南京叫至捕房。
